name: Pop the Ghosts
summary:
The ghosts have taken over the building. Do you have what it takes to drive them all out?

In Pop the Ghosts, you take on the role of a paranormal hunter armed with a special gun. Explore a haunted building, face different types of ghosts, and overcome challenges that become increasingly difficult.

Take on a campaign with 30 platform-style levels, run, jump, break boxes, and explore the environments to find your way to the enemies. Eliminate all the ghosts to advance, but stay alert: some enemies require more than one shot to defeat.

Find TVs to activate checkpoints and watch out for traps scattered throughout the environment, such as dangerous drops of acid falling from the ceiling. Take two hits and you will return to the beginning of the level or to the last checkpoint.
